tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dril bu lha lnga'i sgrub thabs gsal byed ces bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ he yig rol pa ru brjod bral/ /ka yig byed pa shrī yig ni/ /zung 'jug ye shes skur gyur pa/ /de la btud nas sgrub thabs bshad/ /'dir lā ba bcu gsum mar grags pa'i sgrub thabs las 'don pa spos te/ dril bu phyir dkyil lha lnga sgom par 'dod na/ rdor sems sgom zlas yan chad 'dra/ shrī he ru ko3haṃ/ oṃ a ā nas/ rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa lan gsum brjod/ rang gi snying khar ram̐ las/ nas/ dbul bar bgyi'o/ /rang gi snying kha nas spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo drug gis mchod par gyur/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra a dar she hūm̐/ bī ni= gan+dhe= rā se= pu ra she= oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhar me hūm̐/ mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa lha mo bzhis bdud rtsis mchod par bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra mahā su kha nas/ 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan brtsegs pa'i steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ 'dab ma brgyad kyi phyogs bzhir ro'i snying khar zla ba/ mtshams bzhir zla ba'i gdan la bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum thod sna tshogs pad+ma'i mu khyud la 'khor lo gsum gyi rang bzhin gri gug gi 'phreng bas bskor ba/ gzhal med khang gi phyi rol zhes pa nas/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rang nyid 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa zhal mthing ga / g.yas ser/ g.yon dmar/ steng zhal ljang ba nas/ 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ gnyis pa gnyis kyis glang po che'i lpags pa rlon pa 'dzin cing rlung gi 'phyar ba/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍā ma ru/ bzhi pa na dgra sta/ lnga pa na gri gug drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga / bzhi pa na khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ lnga pa na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs mgo rnams 'dzin pa/ dbu'i steng du gdugs dkar po zhes pa nas/ thod khrag 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud cing*/ g.yas rdo rje gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub can/

zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i gar stabs kyis yab la 'khyud pa/ skra grol zhing nas thugs khar hūm̐/ snying khar oṃ ha dkar po nas/ tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo zhes pa'i bar spyi dang mthun/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma sngon po/ byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ /lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ / thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum pa/ phyag g.yon gnyis na thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /g.yas gnyis na gri gug dang ḍā ma ru 'dzin pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing skra grol ba/ rdo rje'i 'phreng bas dbu la brgyan cing mgo'i do shal can/ g.yon brkyang ba'i dkyil dkrung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyi gnas pa dngos grub thams cad stsol ba'o/ kha cig gtso bor 'khor rnams g.yas brkyang ba'i brkyang bskum stabs su 'dod pa ni mun sprul lo/ /lus rjes su dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /tshor ba rjes su dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni lā ma'o/ /chos rjes su dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni dum skyes pa'o/ /sems rjes su dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni gzugs can ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni dpal he ru ka'o/ /dran sogs byang chub yan lag drug /phag mo'o yang dag spong ba dang*/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang dang dad sogs bcu/ 'phags lam rnams ni bum pa bzhi'o/ /thugs kha'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo zhes pa nas yum la mi skyod pa/ lha mo bzhi la rim pa/ rtag pa/ don grub/ 'od dpag med/ rin 'byung rnams kyis dbu brgyan/ tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar lha mo drug dang*/ ma hā su khaṃ gi bar gyis mchod dang*/ rkang pa brgyad pas bstod/ oṃ shrī mahā su kha badz+ra he he ru ru ka ā ཿ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā nas/ ha ho hriḥ rdo rje 'chang dbang rnal 'byor ma/ /dril bu lā ba 'bar 'dzin dang*/ /spyod pa pa dang dge ba'i mgon/ /ti lo nā ro pham ting pa/ /bha dan+ta pa mar do dang*/

/bde mchog rdo rje blo ldan zhabs/ /lho tshad dbang phyug brtson 'grus dang*/ /'phags pa lo mchog grags chen pa/ /'phags 'od bu ston khyung lhas pa/ /nor bzang ka bzhi rin rgyal dang*/ /mkhyen rab chos rje lha bo pa/ /mkhas pa kun dga' don grub dang*/ /bsod nams dpal 'byor bya gling pa/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la mchod/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yang pu rangs lo chung nas brgyud pa ltar na/ bha dan+ta pa lo chung dang*/ /sa chen bsod rtse grags pa'i mtshan/ /sa paṇa bo dong rin chen sems pa che dang*/ yang rtse ba/ bu ston rje dang khyung lhas pa/ man chad gong bzhin/ rang sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags pas lha rnams mchod gtso bo'i bzlas pa'i bar du 'dra ba las/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ lā me hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rū pi nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pa ni 'khor gyi sngags so/ /thun bsdu bar 'dod na rang gi snying kha'i zhes sogs dang*/ gtor ma'i cho ga yang*/ dngos grub thig pa bzhin du bya'o/ /dril bu phyi dkyil lha lnga'i sgrub thabs kyi dgongs 'grel du/ lā ba'i zhabs kyis sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyi sgrub thabs gtsug gi nor bu mdzad/ yan lag phra mo 'ga' zhig ma gtogs/ cho ga'i sgros gcig yin pas/ 'dir yang bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs la 'don pa spos pas/ lha lnga'i sgrub thabs dag cing mchog tu gtsang bar 'byung ngo*/ /mchog tu ngo mtshar zab pa'i gzhung*/ /mkhas pa kun la cher grags kyang*/ /gzhan 'gas ming yang ma thos pa/ /de don rtogs pa bla phyir sbyar/ /dril bu lha lnga'i sgrub thabs gsal byed 'di yang/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo sum bcu pa la gser mdog can du'o/ /bkra shis// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/dril bu lha lnga'i sgrub thabs gsal byed ces bya ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 384 -- PAGE 385 -- PAGE 382 -
